hero.eyebrow: The educational heart of ACADEMY PRIME
hero.headline: LEARN BEFORE YOU TRUST.
hero.subhead: Crypto can give you freedom and opportunity — but knowledge is your first protection.
hero.body: The crypto space moves fast. New projects, tokens, platforms and opportunities appear every day. Unfortunately, scammers move just as fast. ACADEMY PRIME helps you understand how crypto works, recognize common risks, protect your wallet, and make more informed decisions.

message.headline: CRYPTO IS POWERFUL. KNOWLEDGE MAKES IT SAFER.
message.body: You don't need to know everything before entering crypto. But you should understand the basics before trusting a project, connecting your wallet, sending funds, or investing your money. ACADEMY PRIME teaches the fundamentals you need to navigate the ecosystem with greater awareness.

cards.title: UNDERSTAND
cards.body: Learn how blockchain, wallets, tokens, transactions, DeFi and Web3 actually work.

cards.title: RECOGNIZE
cards.body: Learn how scams, fake projects, phishing attempts and manipulation can appear.

cards.title: PROTECT
cards.body: Learn safer habits for protecting your wallet, assets, accounts and personal information.

risk.headline: THE CRYPTO SPACE HAS OPPORTUNITY — AND RISK.
risk.body: Learning helps you understand both sides: what is being built, and what is trying to take advantage of you.

cards.title: Protect Your Wallet
cards.body: Understand wallet addresses, private keys, seed phrases, signatures and transactions.
cards.note: Never share your seed phrase or private key.

cards.title: Recognize Scams
cards.body: Learn how common scams work and understand the warning signs before interacting with suspicious projects, websites or messages.

cards.title: Understand What You're Buying
cards.body: Learn the difference between tokens, coins, stablecoins, NFTs, DeFi protocols, utility tokens and governance tokens. Knowledge helps you ask better questions before making decisions.

cards.title: Verify Before You Trust
cards.body: Teach yourself to verify information rather than blindly trusting influencers, Telegram groups, X posts, Discord communities, websites or advertisements.

cards.title: Understand Transactions
cards.body: Know what happens when you send crypto, receive crypto, connect a wallet, sign a transaction, approve a token, or interact with a smart contract.

cards.title: Protect Your Future
cards.body: Crypto transactions can be irreversible. Understanding what you are doing before signing a transaction can prevent expensive mistakes.

scam.headline: SCAMMERS DON'T WAIT FOR YOU TO BE READY.
scam.body: Scammers often rely on urgency, confusion, fear and greed. They may tell you:
checklist: What happens if something goes wrong?
Am I being pressured to act immediately?

steps.title: STOP
steps.body: Don't act because someone is pressuring you.

steps.title: CHECK
steps.body: Investigate the website, project, wallet address, contract, team and information.

steps.title: VERIFY
steps.body: Use reliable sources and independently confirm what you are being told.

security.headline: YOUR WALLET. YOUR RESPONSIBILITY.
security.body: ACADEMY PRIME can teach you how to recognize risks, but no platform can guarantee that you will never encounter a scam.
rules: Verify websites before connecting your wallet.
security.disclaimer: ACADEMY PRIME provides educational information and does not guarantee investment results or protect users from every possible scam.

finalCta.headline: KNOWLEDGE IS YOUR FIRST DEFENSE.
finalCta.body: The crypto space will continue to evolve. New technologies will appear. New opportunities will appear. And new risks will appear. You cannot control everything that happens in crypto. But you can control how prepared you are. Start learning today.
